arxiv-1905-01225.title: On the rank of the 2 2 -class group of some imaginary triquadratic number fields
arxiv-1905-01225.creator: Abdelmalek Azizi, Mohamed Mahmoud CHEMS-EDDIN, Abdelkader Zekhnini
arxiv-1905-01225.description: Abstract . Let d d be an odd square-free integer and ζ 8 \zeta_{8} a primitive 8 8 -th root of unity. The purpose of this paper is to investigate the rank of the 2 2 -class group of the fields L d = ℚ ⁡ ( ζ 8 , d ) L_{d}=\mathbb{Q}(\zeta_{8},\sqrt{d}) .

arxiv-2104-12276.title: Learning to Better Segment Objects from Unseen Classes with Unlabeled Videos
arxiv-2104-12276.creator: Yuming Du, Yang Xiao, Vincent Lepetit
arxiv-2104-12276.description: Abstract The ability to localize and segment objects from unseen classes would open the door to new applications, such as autonomous object learning in active vision. Nonetheless, improving the performance on unseen classes requires additional training data, while manually annotating the objects of the unseen classes can be labor-extensive and expensive.

arxiv-2110-15069.title: Hidden water in magma ocean exoplanets
arxiv-2110-15069.creator: Caroline Dorn, Tim Lichtenberg
arxiv-2110-15069.description: Abstract We demonstrate that [ the deep volatile storage capacity of] magma oceans [ has significant] implications for the bulk composition, interior and climate state inferred from exoplanet mass and radius data. [ Experimental petrology provides] the fundamental properties on the ability of water and melt to mix.

arxiv-2206-09224.title: Convexity of weakly regular surfaces of distributional nonnegative intrinsic curvature
arxiv-2206-09224.creator: Mohammad Reza Pakzad
arxiv-2206-09224.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Mohammad Reza Pakzad. We prove that the image of an isometric embedding into ℝ 3 {\mathbb{R}}^{3} of a two dimensionnal complete Riemannian manifold ( Σ , g ) (\Sigma,g) without boundary is a convex surface, provided that, first, both the embedding and the metric g g enjoy a C 1 , α C^{1,\alpha} regularity for some α > 2 / 3 \alpha>2/3 , and second, the distributional Gaussian curvature of g g is nonnegative and nonzero.

arxiv-2306-14555.title: Application and analysis of MUSIC algorithm for anomaly detection in microwave imaging without a switching device
arxiv-2306-14555.creator: Won-Kwang Park
arxiv-2306-14555.description: Abstract Although the MUltiple SIgnal Classification (MUSIC) algorithm has demonstrated suitability as a microwave imaging technique for detecting anomalies, there is a fundamental limit that it requires a switching device to be used which permits an antenna to transmit and receive signals simultaneously.

arxiv-2307-01574.title: Secondary gas in debris discs released following the decay of long-lived radioactive nuclides, catastrophic or resurfacing collisions 2023 Secondary gas in debris discs released following the decay of long-lived radioactive nuclides, catastrophic or resurfacing collisions – References
arxiv-2307-01574.creator: Amy Bonsor Mark C. Wyatt, Sebastian Marino, Björn J. R. Davidsson, Quentin Kral, Philippe Thebault
arxiv-2307-01574.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Amy Bonsor Mark C. Wyatt, Sebastian Marino, Björn J. R. Davidsson, Quentin Kral, Philippe Thebault. Kuiper-like belts of planetesimals orbiting stars other than the Sun are most commonly detected from the thermal emission of small dust produced in collisions. Emission from gas, most notably CO, highlights the cometary nature of these planetesimals.

arxiv-2309-07840.title: Recent Progress in Low Energy Neutrino Scattering Physics and Its Implications for the Standard and Beyond the Standard Model Physics
arxiv-2309-07840.creator: V. Pandey
arxiv-2309-07840.description: Abstract Neutrinos continue to provide a testing ground for the structure of the standard model of particle physics as well as hints towards the physics beyond the standard model. Neutrinos of energies spanning over several orders of magnitude, originating in many terrestrial and astrophysical processes, have been detected via various decay and interaction mechanisms.

arxiv-2309-10310.title: TensorCodec: Compact Lossy Compression of Tensors without Strong Data Assumptions
arxiv-2309-10310.creator: Taehyung Kwon 1 , Jihoon Ko 1 , Jinhong Jung 2 , and Kijung Shin 1
arxiv-2309-10310.description: Abstract Many real-world datasets are represented as tensors, i.e., multi-dimensional arrays of numerical values. Storing them without compression often requires substantial space, which grows exponentially with the order. While many tensor compression algorithms are available, many of them rely on strong data assumptions regarding its order, sparsity, rank, and smoothness.

arxiv-2310-16251.title: Speakerly ™ : A Voice-based Writing Assistant for Text Composition
arxiv-2310-16251.creator: Dhruv Kumar, Vipul Raheja, Alice Kaiser-Schatzlein, Robyn PerryApurva Joshi, Justin Hugues-Nuger, Samuel Lou, Navid Chowdhury Grammarly firstname.lastname@grammarly.com
arxiv-2310-16251.description: Abstract We present Speakerly ™ , a new real-time voice-based writing assistance system that helps users with text composition across various use cases such as emails, instant messages, and notes. The user can interact with the system through instructions or dictation, and the system generates a well-formatted and coherent document.

arxiv-2503-19915.title: A New Hope for Obscured AGN: The PRIMA-NewAthena Alliance
arxiv-2503-19915.creator: Luigi Barchiesi, F. J. Carrera, C. Vignali, F. Pozzi, L. Marchetti, C. Gruppioni, I. Delvecchio, L. Bisigello, F. Calura, J. Aird, M. Vaccari
arxiv-2503-19915.description: Abstract Understanding the AGN-galaxy co-evolution, feedback processes, and the evolution of Black Hole Accretion rate Density (BHAD) requires accurately estimating the contribution of obscured Active Galactic Nuclei (AGN). However, detecting these sources is challenging due to significant extinction at the wavelengths typically used to trace their emission.

arxiv-2509-13429.title: Catalpa : GC for a Low-Variance Software Stack
arxiv-2509-13429.creator: Anthony Arnold, Mark Marron
arxiv-2509-13429.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Anthony Arnold, Mark Marron. The performance of an application/runtime is usually conceptualized as a continuous function where, the lower the amount of memory/time used on a given workload, then the better the compiler/runtime is.

arxiv-2510-10880.title: Where on Earth? A Vision-Language Benchmark for Probing Model Geolocation Skills Across Scales
arxiv-2510-10880.creator: Zhaofang Qian, Hardy Chen, Zeyu Wang, Li Zhang, Zijun Wang, Xiaoke Huang, Hui Liu, Xianfeng Tang, Zeyu Zheng, Haoqin Tu, Cihang Xie, Yuyin Zhou
arxiv-2510-10880.description: Abstract Vision–language models (VLMs) have advanced rapidly, yet their capacity for image-grounded geolocation in open-world conditions, a task that is challenging and of demand in real life, has not been comprehensively evaluated. We present EarthWhere , a comprehensive benchmark for VLM image geolocation that evaluates visual recognition, step-by-step reasoning, and evidence use.

arxiv-2512-06427.title: A new initialisation to Control Gradients in Sinusoidal Neural network
arxiv-2512-06427.creator: Andrea Combette, Antoine Venaille, Nelly Pustelnik
arxiv-2512-06427.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Andrea Combette, Antoine Venaille, Nelly Pustelnik. Proper initialisation strategy is of primary importance to mitigate gradient explosion or vanishing when training neural networks. Yet, the impact of initialisation parameters still lacks a precise theoretical understanding for several well-established architectures. Here, we propose a new initialisation for networks with sinusoidal activation functions such as SIREN, focusing on gradients control, their scaling with network depth, their impact on training and on generalization.

arxiv-2602-15229.title: tensorFM: Low-Rank Approximations of Cross-Order Feature Interactions
arxiv-2602-15229.creator: Alessio Mazzetto, Mohammad Mahdi Khalili, Laura Fee Nern, Michael Viderman, Alex Shtoff, Krzysztof Dembczyński
arxiv-2602-15229.description: Abstract We address prediction problems on tabular categorical data, where each instance is defined by multiple categorical attributes, each taking values from a finite set. These attributes are often referred to as fields, and their categorical values as features. Such problems frequently arise in practical applications, including click-through rate prediction and social sciences.

openalex-w2886207958.title: Brain-Derived Neurotrophic Factor in Brain Disorders: Focus on Neuroinflammation
openalex-w2886207958.creator: Bruno Lima Giacobbo, Janine Doorduin, Hans Christiaan Klein, Rudi Dierckx, Elke Bromberg, Erik F. J. de Vries
openalex-w2886207958.description: Brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF) is one of the most studied neurotrophins in the healthy and diseased brain. As a result, there is a large body of evidence that associates BDNF with neuronal maintenance, neuronal survival, plasticity, and neurotransmitter regulation....

pmc-10624861.title: HLA allele-calling using multi-ancestry whole-exome sequencing from the UK Biobank identifies 129 novel associations in 11 autoimmune diseases
pmc-10624861.creator: Guillaume Butler-Laporte, Joseph Farjoun, Tomoko Nakanishi, Tianyuan Lu, Erik Abner, Yiheng Chen, Michael Hultström, Andres Metspalu, Lili Milani, Reedik Mägi, Mari Nelis, Georgi Hudjashov, Erik Abner, Erik Abner, Andres Metspalu, Lili Milani, Reedik Mägi, Mari Nelis, Georgi Hudjashov, Tõnu Esko, Sa
pmc-10624861.description: The human leukocyte antigen (HLA) region on chromosome 6 is strongly associated with many immune-mediated and infection-related diseases. Due to its highly polymorphic nature and complex linkage disequilibrium patterns, traditional genetic association studies of single nucleotide polymorphisms do not perform well in this region. Instead, the field has adopted the assessment of the association of HLA alleles (i.e.

pmc-11476472.title: Utilizing Adenovirus Knob Proteins as Carriers in Cancer Gene Therapy Amidst the Presence of Anti-Knob Antibodies
pmc-11476472.creator: Naoya Koizumi, Takamasa Hirai, Junpei Kano, Anna Sato, Yurika Suzuki, Arisa Sasaki, Tetsuya Nomura, Naoki Utoguchi, Pier Paolo Claudio
pmc-11476472.description: Numerous gene therapy drugs for cancer have received global approval, yet their efficacy against solid tumors remains inadequate. Our previous research indicated that the fiber protein, a component of the adenovirus capsid, can propagate from infected cells to neighboring cells that express the adenovirus receptor.

pmc-12751868.title: The Global Hypophosphatasia Registry: lessons learned from a decade of real-world data
pmc-12751868.creator: Priya S Kishnani, Lothar Seefried, Keiichi Ozono, Gabriel Ángel Martos-Moreno, Cheryl Rockman-Greenberg, Deborah Fowler, Luke K Burke, William R Mowrey, Eric T Rush, Peter R Ebeling, Wolfgang Högler, Agnès Linglart, Shona Fang, Anna Petryk, Kathryn M Dahir
pmc-12751868.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). IntroductionHypophosphatasia (HPP) is an inherited, metabolic, rare disease characterized by a high level of clinical heterogeneity. In response to this robust heterogeneity, the Global HPP Registry was formed to characterize the types of manifestations that patients may experience, as well as to compile information on genetic underpinnings of the disease, overall impact on patient quality of life, and safety and effectiveness of enzyme replacement therapy.

pmc-12754782.title: Development of a vaccine construct against Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia using computational tools
pmc-12754782.creator: Ragini Mishra, Nahid Akhtar, Jorge Samuel Leon Magdeleno, Abdul Rajjak Shaikh, Manik Prabhu Narsing Rao, Neeta Raj Sharma, Luigi Cavallo, Mohit Chawla
pmc-12754782.description: Pneumocystis jirovecii poses a significant threat to immunocompromised individuals, necessitating the development of an effective vaccine. This study employs an immunoinformatics approach to design a promising vaccine candidate against P. jirovecii. Utilizing various computational tools, the study identified potential antigenic epitopes capable of eliciting immune responses within the P. jirovecii major surface glycoprotein C.

pmc-12768785.title: PD04 Economic Evaluation Of Neonatal Screening Strategies For Congenital Cytomegalovirus In Spain
pmc-12768785.creator: Guillem Torres-Pagès, Jessica Ruiz-Baena, M. Pellicer, Ana Alarcón, Maria Dolors Estrada Sabadell, Rosa Maria Vivanco-Hidalgo
pmc-12768785.description: Introduction Congenital cytomegalovirus (CMVc) is a major cause of neonatal morbidity, with long-term effects such as hearing loss and neurodevelopmental impairments. Screening strategies, including systematic and targeted approaches, aim to improve early detection and management. This study evaluated the cost utility of these strategies to inform decision-making in Spain’s healthcare system.

pmc-12800849.title: No Difference in Clinical Outcomes Between Concomitant Anterior and Posterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction With and Without Independent Suture Tape Augmentation
pmc-12800849.creator: Adam J. Tagliero, Brandon Cabarcas, Sanathan Iyer, Adam V. Daniel, John J. Kelly, Aaron J. Krych, Bruce A. Levy
pmc-12800849.description: PurposeTo compare clinical and functional outcomes (including range of motion, clinical laxity, reoperation/revision rates, and patient-reported outcome measures) of combined anterior cruciate ligament/posterior cruciate ligament reconstruction (ACLR/PCLR) with and without suture tape (ST) augmentation via a propensity-matched cohort analysis.MethodsA retrospective review was performed to identify all patients who underwent simultaneous primary ACLR/PCLR between 2001 and 2022.

pmc-12960888.title: Exploring LCME’s New USMLE Norms of Accomplishment: Medical School Self-Reflection to Support Continuous Quality Improvement
pmc-12960888.creator: Mark Grichanik, Rivka C. Stone
pmc-12960888.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The Liaison Committee on Medical Education has introduced new norms for United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE) performance. Improving USMLE outcomes is a complex intervention that requires careful deliberation of tradeoffs, the coordination of many people and systems, and the marshalling of significant resources, so it is important that any increased attention to USMLE processes is approached strategically through a continuous quality improvement lens.

pmc-13039358.title: Targeting cell death in Crohn’s disease: from mechanisms to medicines
pmc-13039358.creator: Ying Zhang, Yifan Zhou, Junyan Gao, Jiahui Jia, Xuanming Fan, Miao He, Zixuan He, Yu Bai
pmc-13039358.description: Crohn’s disease (CD) is a chronic inflammatory granulomatous disease that can damage the gastrointestinal tract. Existing treatment methods often fail to achieve satisfactory clinical effects. Although the pathogenesis of CD has not been fully elucidated, increasing evidence suggests that programmed cell death plays a key role in disease progression.

pmc-13049942.title: The relevance of sputum galectin-7 levels to clinical and prognostic factors in patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease: a prospective cohort study from China
pmc-13049942.creator: Wenqiang He, Xueping Li, Haining Huang, Zitong Tang, Junqing Zhu, Yuqiong Yang, Zizheng Chen, Chengyu Miao, Huajing Yang, Shanshan Zha, Zifei Zhou, Jiachun Liu, Zhenyu Liang, Rongchang Chen, Fengyan Wang
pmc-13049942.description: ObjectiveGalectin-7, a β-galactoside-binding lectin involved in inflammation, immune regulation, and apoptosis, has been implicated in the development and progression of various lung diseases. Inflammation, immune dysregulation, and epithelial cell apoptosis are key pathophysiological mechanisms underlying chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). However, the clinical significance of galectin-7 in COPD remains unclear.

pmc-13059019.title: Extracellular vesicles derived from hADSCs rescue acute pancreatitis by carrying p-STK3 to regulate Treg differentiation
pmc-13059019.creator: Rongli Xie, Guohui Xiao, Kaige Yang, Xiaofeng Wang, Cong Chen, Tong Zhou, Ying Chen, Erzhen Chen, Zhitao Yang, Jian Fei, Dan Xu
pmc-13059019.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). SummarySevere acute pancreatitis (SAP) is a complex inflammatory disorder with severe immune imbalance. This study investigates the therapeutic potential of extracellular vesicles derived from human adipose mesenchymal stem cells (hADSC-EVs) in modulating Treg differentiation and alleviating SAP. We conducted a phosphoproteomics analysis to evaluate phosphorylation levels, and administered hADSC-EVs in a mouse model of SAP and assessed their impact on Treg differentiation. Phosphoproteomics revealed a significant increase in p-STK3 following hADSC-EVs treatment, restoring Foxp3 level diminished by STK3 knockdown.

pmc-13219509.title: Global Gridded Climate-Responsive Crop Selection: Sowing Dates and Crop Varieties in a Warming World
pmc-13219509.creator: Sneha Chevuru, Rens L. P. H. van Beek, Michelle T. H. van Vliet, Marc F. P. Bierkens
pmc-13219509.description: Farmers face increasing challenges in maintaining stable crop production as climate change alters growing conditions through higher temperatures, variable rainfall, and extreme weather events. To adapt, farmers often select new crop varieties and adjust planting dates before changing crops, as these strategies involve lower costs and risks.

pmc-13449663.title: Clinical efficacy of single-port transscrotal laparoscopic orchiopexy combined with hernia needle for palpable undescended testes in children
pmc-13449663.creator: Quan Lin, Shan Li, Weifeng Zhang, Jun Zhang, Qian Ding, Xiaofang Wang, Hui Shang
pmc-13449663.description: ObjectiveTo investigate the clinical efficacy and safety of single-port transscrotal laparoscopic orchiopexy combined with a hernia needle (SPLT-Orchiopexy) in children with palpable middle- and low-position undescended testes.MethodsA retrospective analysis was conducted on 200 children with palpable middle- and low-position undescended testes who underwent surgical treatment at our hospital between March 2021 and April 2023.

pmc-13577438.title: Dumping Syndrome Following Endoscopic Sleeve Gastroplasty
pmc-13577438.creator: Muhab Saadeh, Zain Albdour, Anas Zaher, Bashar Qumseya
pmc-13577438.description: Dumping syndrome is a recognized complication of bariatric surgery but has not been previously reported following endoscopic sleeve gastroplasty (ESG). We present a woman in her mid-30s who underwent ESG in 2022, achieving a body mass index reduction from 35.4 to 26.7 kg/m2.
